title: Same 36 cells, two shapes: which reads as an animal?
question: Which of these two reads as a creature rather than a smudge? Pick one, and say in a sentence what makes it read that way.
context_md:
Now that a body scales with the grid, the extra cells have to be spent on a *shape*. These are the two shapes the repo already has, both at double density, both **exactly 36 cells**, both standing still on the same ground at the same hour.

| | plan | on screen | cannot move |
|---|---|---|---|
| one | 3x3 block supersampled | 6 x 6 cells | **73%** of decisions |
| two | waisted 5x2 supersampled | 10 x 4 cells | **51%** of decisions |

The shipped two-cell ant is blocked **5%** of the time, so both of these are animals that mostly cannot walk. That is the next problem and it is not this question.

**This question is only about the silhouette**, because it decides where the cells go. Judge a still: a body that moves is findable at any size, so standing still is the honest test.
